job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is a City of York, Pennsylvania investment manager/adviser/consultant RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. It does not state a minimum experience requirement for a lead actuary.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR INVESTMENT MANAGER/ADVISER/CONSULTANT CITY OF YORK PENSION FUNDS
The City of York, Pennsylvania, (the “City” or “York”) seeks an Investment Manager, Adviser or Consultant for its Municipal Pension Funds

Name, title, role, education, years of service with Firm, years investment experience and other deemed relevant information or biographies for the portfolio manager(s), research analysts, marketing, client service and key personnel involved in the proposed service
